semiconductor_relevance: High — Wacom Manufacturing produces high-precision quartz glass and silicone rubber products specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wacom Manufacturing Co., Ltd. specializes in producing high-precision quartz glass and silicone rubber products, such as rectangular tanks, process tubes, and boats, tailored for semiconductor manufacturing. The company focuses on preventing contamination by manufacturing in clean environments and enhances operational efficiency through in-house development of equipment and fixtures.
capabilities: Silicone rubber products for semiconductor processes
Process tubes and boats designed for contamination prevention
